---
- name: Install and configure zsh for dev
  hosts: all
  become: true

  tasks:
    - name: Install zsh
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: zsh
        state: present

    - name: Set zsh as dev's default shell
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: dev
        shell: /bin/zsh
        create_home: true
        state: present

    - name: Look up dev's home directory and primary group
      ansible.builtin.getent:
        database: passwd
        key: dev

    - name: Ensure dev's zsh configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ansible_facts.getent_passwd['dev'][4] }}/.zshrc"
        state: touch
        owner: dev
        group: "{{ ansible_facts.getent_passwd['dev'][2] }}"
        mode: "0644"
        access_time: preserve
        modification_time: preserve

- name: Move file
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Copy file to new location
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: /scratch/file.txt
        dest: /home/user/data.txt
        remote_src: true

    - name: Remove original file
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /scratch/file.txt
        state: absent

```yaml
---
- name: Copy all .war files from remote /tmp to controller /backup
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure /backup exists on controller
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /backup
        state: directory
      delegate_to: localhost
      run_once: true

    - name: Find all .war files in /tmp on remote
      ansible.builtin.find:
        paths: /tmp
        patterns: "*.war"
      register: war_files

    - name: Fetch each .war file to controller /backup
      ansible.builtin.fetch:
        src: "{{ item.path }}"
        dest: /backup/
        flat: true
      loop: "{{ war_files.files }}"
```

```yaml
---
- name: Manage postfix configuration
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    postfix_config_path: /etc/postfix/main.cf
    postfix_config_url: "{{ 'http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu' if ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian' else 'http://example.com/cfg.redhat' }}"
    postfix_downloaded_config: /tmp/postfix_main.cf.new

  tasks:
    - name: Install the latest version of postfix
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: postfix
        state: latest

    - name: Backup the default postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_config_path }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_path }}.bak"
        remote_src: true
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Download the new postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_url }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_downloaded_config }}"
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Deploy the downloaded postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_downloaded_config }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_path }}"
        remote_src: true
        mode: "0644"
        backup: true
      notify: Restart postfix

  handlers:
    - name: Restart postfix
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
  tasks:
```

```yaml
        path: /home/user

    - name: Copy the source file to the destination, preserving its attributes
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: /scratch/file.txt
        dest: /home/user/data.txt
        remote_src: true
        mode: preserve
      when: source_file.stat.exists

    - name: Remove the original source file
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /scratch/file.txt
        state: absent
      when: source_file.stat.exists
```

```yaml
---
- name: Install and configure postfix on RedHat and Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    postfix_config_file: /etc/postfix/main.cf
    postfix_config_backup: /etc/postfix/main.cf.bak
    postfix_config_urls:
      RedHat: http://example.com/cfg.redhat
      Ubuntu: http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu

  tasks:
    - name: Install the latest version of postfix on RedHat
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"

    - name: Install the latest version of postfix on Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_facts['distribution'] == "Ubuntu"

    - name: Check whether the default postfix configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
      register: postfix_cfg_stat
      when: >
        ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat" or
        ansible_facts['distribution'] == "Ubuntu"

    - name: Backup the default postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_backup }}"
        remote_src: true
        force: false
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when:
        - ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat" or ansible_facts['distribution'] == "Ubuntu"
        - postfix_cfg_stat.stat is defined
        - postfix_cfg_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Download the postfix configuration file for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_urls['RedHat'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        force: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Download the postfix configuration file for Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_urls['Ubuntu'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        force: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when: ansible_facts['distribution'] == "Ubuntu"
      notify: Restart postfix

  handlers:
    - name: Restart postfix
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
---
- name: Install zsh and configure it as default shell for user dev
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    target_user: dev
    zsh_path: /bin/zsh

  tasks:
    - name: Install zsh package
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: zsh
        state: present

    - name: Verify zsh binary exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ zsh_path }}"
      register: zsh_binary

    - name: Fall back to /usr/bin/zsh if /bin/zsh is missing
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        zsh_path: /usr/bin/zsh
      when: not zsh_binary.stat.exists

    - name: Set zsh as default shell for user {{ target_user }}
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ target_user }}"
        shell: "{{ zsh_path }}"
      register: dev_user

    - name: Ensure .zshrc exists for user {{ target_user }}
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ dev_user.home }}/.zshrc"
        state: touch
        owner: "{{ target_user }}"
        group: "{{ dev_user.group | default(target_user) }}"
        mode: "0644"
        modification_time: preserve
        access_time: preserve
```

```yaml
- name: Restart Debian systems when a reboot is required
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  tasks:
    - name: Debian-specific reboot handling
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
      block:
        - name: Check Debian reboot-required flag file
          ansible.builtin.stat:
            path: /var/run/reboot-required
          register: debian_reboot_required

        - name: Reboot if Debian reports reboot is required
          ansible.builtin.reboot:
            msg: "Rebooting because Debian reboot-required flag is present"
            pre_reboot_delay: 0
            reboot_timeout: 600
          when: debian_reboot_required.stat.exists
```

---
- name: Install SSH client and server and generate fizbaz's SSH key
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    ssh_packages:
      Debian:
        - openssh-client
        - openssh-server
      RedHat:
        - openssh-clients
        - openssh-server
    ssh_services:
      Debian: ssh
      RedHat: sshd

  tasks:
    - name: Verify the operating system is supported
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_facts['os_family'] in ['Debian', 'RedHat']
        fail_msg: This playbook supports Debian and RedHat families only.

    - name: Install SSH client and server
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ ssh_packages[ansible_facts['os_family']] }}"
        state: present

    - name: Ensure fizbaz exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: fizbaz
        state: present
        create_home: true

    - name: Create the requested SSH directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /.ssh
        state: directory
        owner: fizbaz
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Generate an RSA SSH key for fizbaz
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: fizbaz
        generate_ssh_key: true
        ssh_key_type: rsa
        ssh_key_bits: 4096
        ssh_key_file: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
        ssh_key_comment: fizbaz
        force: false

    - name: Enforce private key permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
        owner: fizbaz
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Enable and start the SSH server
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ ssh_services[ansible_facts['os_family']] }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

```yaml
---
- name: Install zsh and configure it as the default shell for user dev
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    target_user: dev
    zsh_candidate_paths:
      - /bin/zsh
      - /usr/bin/zsh
      - /usr/local/bin/zsh

  tasks:
    - name: Install zsh package
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: zsh
        state: present

    - name: Locate the zsh binary
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ item }}"
      loop: "{{ zsh_candidate_paths }}"
      register: zsh_stat

    - name: Set the zsh path fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        zsh_path: >-
          {{ (zsh_stat.results
              | selectattr('stat.exists')
              | map(attribute='item')
              | list
              | first) | default('/bin/zsh') }}

    - name: Ensure zsh is listed in /etc/shells
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/shells
        line: "{{ zsh_path }}"
        state: present
        create: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Ensure user dev exists and uses zsh as the default shell
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ target_user }}"
        shell: "{{ zsh_path }}"
        state: present
        create_home: true

    - name: Retrieve passwd information for user dev
      ansible.builtin.getent:
        database: passwd
        key: "{{ target_user }}"

    - name: Set home directory fact for user dev
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        target_user_home: "{{ getent_passwd[target_user][4] }}"

    - name: Get primary group of user dev
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        target_user_gid: "{{ getent_passwd[target_user][2] }}"

    - name: Ensure the .zshrc configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ target_user_home }}/.zshrc"
        state: touch
        owner: "{{ target_user }}"
        group: "{{ target_user_gid }}"
        mode: "0644"
        access_time: preserve
        modification_time: preserve
```

```yaml
- name: Install and configure postfix on RedHat and Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    postfix_config_file: /etc/postfix/main.cf
    postfix_config_backup: /etc/postfix/main.cf.bak
    postfix_config_urls:
      RedHat: http://example.com/cfg.redhat
      Ubuntu: http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu

  tasks:
    - name: Install the latest version of postfix on RedHat
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat'

    - name: Install the latest version of postfix on Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'

    - name: Check if the default postfix configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
      register: postfix_cfg_stat
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat' or ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'

    - name: Backup the default postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_backup }}"
        remote_src: true
        force: false
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      when:
        - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat' or ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'
        - postfix_cfg_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_urls['RedHat'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        force: true
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat'
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_urls['Ubuntu'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        force: true
      when: ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'
      notify: Restart postfix

  handlers:
    - name: Restart postfix
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
        name: postfix
        state: latest
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat' or ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'

    - name: Check whether the default postfix configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
      register: postfix_cfg_stat
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat' or ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'

    - name: Backup the default postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_backup }}"
        remote_src: true
        force: false
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when:
        - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat' or ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'
        - postfix_cfg_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_url['Ubuntu'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        force: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when: ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_url['RedHat'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        force: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat'
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Ensure postfix is started and enabled
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: started
        enabled: true
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat' or ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu'

  handlers:
    - name: Restart postfix
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
        name: wheel
        state: present

        name: ansible

        state: present
```

```yaml
        group: root
```

```yaml
  become: true
```
  gather_facts: true

```yaml
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /var/run/reboot-required
```

---
- name: Install SSH and generate a key for fizbaz
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    ssh_packages:
      Debian:
        - openssh-client
        - openssh-server
      RedHat:
        - openssh-clients
        - openssh-server
    ssh_services:
      Debian: ssh
      RedHat: sshd

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Verify supported operating system
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_facts['os_family'] in ssh_packages
        fail_msg: This playbook supports Debian and RedHat families only.

  tasks:
    - name: Refresh Debian package cache
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'

    - name: Install SSH client and server
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ ssh_packages[ansible_facts['os_family']] }}"
        state: present

    - name: Enable and start the SSH server
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ ssh_services[ansible_facts['os_family']] }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Ensure the fizbaz group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: fizbaz
        state: present

    - name: Ensure the fizbaz user exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: fizbaz
        group: fizbaz
        create_home: true
        state: present

    - name: Create the requested SSH key directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /.ssh
        state: directory
        owner: fizbaz
        group: fizbaz
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Generate an RSA SSH key for fizbaz
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: fizbaz
        generate_ssh_key: true
        ssh_key_type: rsa
        ssh_key_bits: 4096
        ssh_key_file: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa

The capital `X` adds execute permission only to directories and to files that already have execute permission for someone. Directories end up as `755`, so everyone can list and enter them. Regular files become `644`, so everyone can read them and only the owner can write. Any file that was already executable stays executable.


The capital `X` adds execute permission only to directories and to files that are already executable. The result is:

- **Directories** get `0755`, so everyone can list and enter them.
- **Regular files** get `0644`, so everyone can read them but only the owner can write.
- **Files that were already executable** keep their execute bits.

- `become: true` is included because writing to `/etc` typically requires root privileges.

```yaml
---
- name: Set permissions under /srv/path so everyone can read but only the owner can write
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Set read/list for all users and write for the owner only (recursively)
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /srv/path
        state: directory
        recurse: true
        mode: "u=rwX,g=rX,o=rX"
```

The symbolic mode with a capital `X` gives each type of item the right permissions:

- **Directories** get execute permission, so everyone can list and enter them. They end up as `0755`.
- **Regular files** stay readable by everyone and writable only by the owner. They end up as `0644`, or `0755` if they were already executable.
- **Write permission** is removed for group and others everywhere, so only the owner can write.

```yaml
  hosts: all
```

```yaml
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'

    - name: Install SSH client and server
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ ssh_packages_map[ansible_facts['os_family']] }}"
        state: present

      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ ssh_service_map[ansible_facts['os_family']] }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure user fizbaz exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: fizbaz
        state: present
        shell: /bin/bash
        create_home: true

    - name: Ensure /.ssh directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /.ssh
        state: directory
        owner: fizbaz
        group: fizbaz
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Generate SSH key for fizbaz at /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: fizbaz
        generate_ssh_key: true
        ssh_key_type: rsa

        ssh_key_file: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa

    - name: Ensure private key permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
        owner: fizbaz
        group: fizbaz
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Ensure public key permissions

        path: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa.pub
        owner: fizbaz
        group: fizbaz
        mode: "0644"
```

```yaml
        update_cache: true

        name: postfix
        state: latest
      when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Check if default postfix configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
      register: postfix_cfg_stat
      when: ansible_distribution == 'Ubuntu' or ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'

    - name: Backup default postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_backup }}"
        remote_src: true
        force: false
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      when:
        - ansible_distribution == 'Ubuntu' or ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'
        - postfix_cfg_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        force: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      when: ansible_distribution == 'Ubuntu'
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: http://example.com/cfg.redhat
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        force: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      when: ansible_os_family == 'RedHat'
      notify: Restart postfix

  handlers:
    - name: Restart postfix
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
---
- name: Copy all .war files from /tmp on remote hosts to /backup on the controller
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure /backup directory exists on the controller
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /backup
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"
      delegate_to: localhost
      run_once: true

    - name: Find all .war files in /tmp on the remote machine
      ansible.builtin.find:
        paths: /tmp
        patterns: "*.war"
        file_type: file
        recurse: false
      register: war_files

    - name: Fetch .war files from the remote machine to /backup on the controller
      ansible.builtin.fetch:
        src: "{{ item.path }}"
        dest: "/backup/"
        flat: true
      loop: "{{ war_files.files }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.path }}"
```

The playbook first creates `/backup` on the controller, then finds every `.war` file in `/tmp` on each remote host and fetches it.

`flat: true` places the files directly in `/backup`. If several hosts have `.war` files with the same name, later fetches will overwrite earlier ones. To keep them separate, change `dest` to `"/backup/{{ inventory_hostname }}/"`. That puts each host's files in its own subdirectory.

```yaml
---
- name: Move /scratch/file.txt to /home/user/data.txt
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    src_file: /scratch/file.txt
    dest_file: /home/user/data.txt

  tasks:
    - name: Check whether the source file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ src_file }}"
      register: src_stat

    - name: Fail if the source file does not exist
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "Source file {{ src_file }} does not exist."
      when: not src_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Ensure the destination directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ dest_file | dirname }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Copy the source file to the destination, preserving its mode
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ src_file }}"
        dest: "{{ dest_file }}"
        remote_src: true
        mode: preserve
        owner: "{{ src_stat.stat.pw_name }}"
        group: "{{ src_stat.stat.gr_name }}"
      register: copy_result

    - name: Verify the destination file matches the source
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ dest_file }}"
        checksum_algorithm: sha1
      register: dest_stat

    - name: Fail if the checksums do not match
      ansible.builtin.fail:
```

```yaml
- name: Install and start SSH client/server and generate SSH key for fizbaz
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    ssh_user: fizbaz
    ssh_key_dir: /.ssh
    ssh_key_path: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa

  tasks:
    - name: Set SSH package and service names for Debian
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        ssh_packages:
          - openssh-client
          - openssh-server
        ssh_service: ssh
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "Debian"

    - name: Set SSH package and service names for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        ssh_packages:
          - openssh-clients
          - openssh-server
        ssh_service: sshd
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"

    - name: Fail on unsupported OS family
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "Unsupported OS family: {{ ansible_facts['os_family'] }}"
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] not in ['Debian', 'RedHat']

    - name: Update apt cache on Debian
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "Debian"

    - name: Install SSH client and server
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ ssh_packages }}"
        state: present

    - name: Ensure SSH server is started and enabled
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ ssh_service }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure user fizbaz exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        state: present
        create_home: true

    - name: Ensure SSH key directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ssh_key_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        group: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Generate SSH key for fizbaz
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        generate_ssh_key: true
        ssh_key_type: rsa
        ssh_key_bits: 4096
        ssh_key_file: "{{ ssh_key_path }}"
        ssh_key_comment: "{{ ssh_user }}@{{ ansible_facts['hostname'] }}"

    - name: Ensure private key has correct ownership and permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ssh_key_path }}"
        owner: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        group: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Ensure public key has correct ownership and permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ssh_key_path }}.pub"
        owner: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        group: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        mode: "0644"
```

```yaml
- name: Install and start SSH client/server and generate SSH key for fizbaz
  hosts: all
  become: true

  vars:
    ssh_user: fizbaz
    ssh_key_path: /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa

  tasks:
    - name: Set SSH package and service names for Debian
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        ssh_packages:
          - openssh-client
          - openssh-server
        ssh_service: ssh
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'

    - name: Set SSH package and service names for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        ssh_packages:
          - openssh-clients
          - openssh-server
        ssh_service: sshd
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat'

    - name: Fail if OS family is not supported
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "Unsupported OS family: {{ ansible_facts['os_family'] }}"
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] not in ['Debian', 'RedHat']

    - name: Update apt cache on Debian
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'

    - name: Install SSH client and server
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ ssh_packages }}"
        state: present

    - name: Ensure SSH server is started and enabled
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ ssh_service }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure user fizbaz exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        state: present
        create_home: true

    - name: Ensure /.ssh directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /.ssh
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        group: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Generate SSH key for fizbaz at /.ssh/fizbaz_rsa
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ ssh_user }}"
        generate_ssh_key: true
        ssh_key_type: rsa
        ssh_key_bits: 4096
        ssh_key_file: "{{ ssh_key_path }}"
        ssh_key_comment: "{{ ssh_user }}@{{ ansible_facts['hostname'] }}"
```

```yaml
---
- name: Install and configure Postfix on RedHat and Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true

  vars:
    postfix_config_file: /etc/postfix/main.cf
    postfix_config_backup: /etc/postfix/main.cf.bak
    postfix_config_urls:
      Ubuntu: http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu
      RedHat: http://example.com/cfg.redhat

  tasks:
    - name: Install the latest version of postfix on Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu"

    - name: Install the latest version of postfix on RedHat
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: postfix
        state: latest
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Check whether the default postfix configuration file exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
      register: postfix_cfg_stat
      when: ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu" or ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Back up the default postfix configuration file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_backup }}"
        remote_src: true
        force: false
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      when:
        - ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu" or ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
        - postfix_cfg_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_urls['Ubuntu'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        force: true
      when: ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu"
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Download postfix configuration file for RedHat
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ postfix_config_urls['RedHat'] }}"
        dest: "{{ postfix_config_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        force: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
      notify: Restart postfix

    - name: Ensure postfix service is enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: started
        enabled: true
      when: ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu" or ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

  handlers:
    - name: Restart postfix
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: postfix
        state: restarted
```

```yaml
- name: Set permissions under /srv/path so everyone can read but only the owner can write
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure /srv/path exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /srv/path
      register: srv_path

    - name: Fail if /srv/path does not exist
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "/srv/path does not exist"
      when: not srv_path.stat.exists

    - name: Set the top-level directory to 0755
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /srv/path
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Find all directories under /srv/path
      ansible.builtin.find:
        paths: /srv/path
        file_type: directory
        recurse: true
        hidden: true
      register: found_dirs

    - name: Set directories to 0755 (owner rwx, others r-x)
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"
      loop: "{{ found_dirs.files }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.path }}"

    - name: Find all files under /srv/path
      ansible.builtin.find:
        paths: /srv/path
        file_type: file
        recurse: true
        hidden: true
      register: found_files

    - name: Set files to 0644 (owner rw, others r)
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: file
        mode: "0644"
      loop: "{{ found_files.files }}"
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.path }}"
```

The symbolic mode `u=rwX,go=rX` works as follows:

- **Owner (`u=rwX`)**: can read and write everything.
- **Group and others (`go=rX`)**: can read everything.
- **Capital `X`**: adds execute (search) permission only on directories and on files that already have an execute bit. This lets all users list and enter directories without making regular files executable.

The result is `0755` on directories and `0644` on regular files. Files that were already executable get `0755`.

            src: /etc/postfix/main.cf

            remote_src: true
            force: false
            owner: root
            group: root
            mode: preserve

          ansible.builtin.get_url:
            url: "{{ 'http://example.com/cfg.ubuntu' if ansible_facts['distribution'] == 'Ubuntu' else 'http://example.com/cfg.redhat' }}"
            dest: /etc/postfix/main.cf
            owner: root
            group: root
            mode: "0644"
            force: true

```yaml
      loop_control:
        label: "{{ item.path }}"
```
